data.description:
LAX VR is the ultimate first-person VR lacrosse experience, offering both Box and Field lacrosse modes, including an exhilarating 6v6 field game where you can play as a field player, long pole, or goalie. Game modes include: Field, Box, Braveheart, Shooting, Goalie, Longstick, Shoot Around, and Wall Ball. Our Medicine Game pays tribute to the Indigenous roots of lacrosse, set in a mythical historic environment. Hone your skills, customize your twig, and enjoy the immersive world of VR lacrosse. Start a box or field 6v6 tourney and aim for the Championship!

The latest release adds a new expansion (IAP) with 10v10 field play, featuring a Coaches Mode. Change middie lines, call timeouts, manage the tempo, and yell at refs in this added mode. Note: Expansion is a separate purchase from the base game.

Unique touch controller physics replicate the feel of a real lacrosse stick, and as a family-friendly game with a one-time cost, there are no hidden fees. Compete globally on the leaderboards to compare skills and aim for the top.

LAX VR delivers a fun, realistic lacrosse experience. Practice your skills in various modes, and customize your twig with colors for max style!

changelog.change_log: Changed how we handle calibration which should eliminate the camera from scaling and causing unusual FOV issues.  Added a calibration option for real height vs fixed height.  Fixed an issue with face off in 10v10 mode.
More fixes for Field Of View and/or scaling issues.  Items more uniform across modes now.  Wall Graffiti.  Scoreboard flickering fixed in 10v10.
Some players are experiencing weird issues where objects are appearing larger than they should be and other field of view issues.
patch to update some depth and field of view issues some users are having related to a dynamic performance configuration.

Version 2.02

New expansion:  10v10 & Coach's Mode.  An upgrade needs to be purchased to unlock 10v10. This is our first non-free update in over 2 years since the game started, as all new features have been free.  Our plan is to limit paid upgrades to once a year, and continue to push free updates every 1-2 months.

Shooting dynamics have been updated in all game modes to take into account the player's body movement towards the goal.  Moving towards the goal will result in harder shots, and moving away from goal will reduce shot power.  Controller speed is still a key ingredient to shot power.  We have added a power meter to most modes as well.

Other small enhancements and fixes have been made.
Fixed an issue where the AI players were not passing.

July 9, 2024

* Added an option, via the main menu, to turn off background music.

* For faceoffs just the top of the head is required to touch the faceoff stick for those who don't like kneeling down.  

* We dialed up the stick checks and body checks for more fun gameplay.
New: Tourney Mode, play 6 on 6 tourneys, Customize uniform colors, play 6v6 field with a pole.  Enhanced shooting/passing dynamics.   Other bug fixes.
Added link to Face Off, our new multiplayer game.  Adjusted scoring.  Added controller option for people with drift issues

+ New Sixes Uni's.
+ Faster graphics performance.  Better FPS.
+ Nerfed the sixes goalie; easier to score.
+ Other improvements and bug fixes.

+ Updated goalie sticks. The stick inherits some of the custom colors and is a better shape.  We will keep improving it.
+ Our box goalie was able to trade in his old hockey leg guards for some new gear. 
+ In field 6v6 we improved the visuals.  The helms and your stick head now have a glossy finish.  Jerseys updated too.
+ Performance enhancements.

November 15, 2023

- Custom sticks can now have 2 color heads.
- New  menu system.
- Performance improvements in the frame rate.
- Fixed bug in shooting challenge were ball would fly in unexpected direction (sorry about that).
- Fixed bugs in Medicine game that caused the stick to get stuck.
Added stick customizations.  Performance improvements were also made.
Updated visuals.  Added support for Quest 3.  Fixed a bug where the default shoot aim was the joystick rather than the headset.

+ Revamped Shooting skill mode
+ Cleaned up the main menu
+ Field goalie has been tweaked
+ Several other fixes and enhancements.
